Range: 150 to 210 USD/MWh (41.7 to 58.3 USD/GJ).

ASSUMPTION: the Costa Rica natural gas supply price is 7.763 USD/GJ gross (8.626 USD/GJ net) in 2024, real 2024 USD, at import level, and moves with Henry Hub before 2026 and with the IEA WEO 2025 United States gas price after 2025. Reason: Costa Rica has no natural gas imports, LNG terminal or gas network, so the price is the delivered cost of a first small-scale LNG supply from the US Gulf Coast: the 2024 Henry Hub average of 2.08 USD/GJ (2.19 USD/MMBtu / 1.055056 GJ/MMBtu) plus 4.26 USD/GJ for liquefaction and export plus 1.42 USD/GJ for small-scale shipping and regasification. Check: the Honduras system operator expansion plan 2026-2035 builds its delivered LNG price on Henry Hub plus 15 percent buyer costs, 2 USD/MMBtu liquefaction and 0.3 USD/MMBtu shipping and import, which gives about 5.5 USD/GJ for 2024. Range: 5.5 to 12 USD/GJ gross. ASSUMPTION: natural gas prices published per MMBtu are on a gross calorific basis and are converted to the models' net basis by dividing by 0.9 (net = 0.9 x gross for natural gas, UN Statistics Division), for all six countries and all years. Reason: natural gas in the Americas, Henry Hub included, is priced on a gross basis, and the energy balances behind the models follow the UN recommendation to use net values (IRES, UN 2018). Check: EIA reports US natural gas at 1,037 Btu per cubic foot, a gross value. Range: a source already on a net basis would be overstated by about 11 percent.
